name: Last Guardian 2 ~Yomi no Fuuin~
original_name: ラストガーディアン2 ～黄泉の封印～
source:
Last Guardian 2: Yomi no Fūin is a direct sequel to the first game in the Last Guardian series. It continues the unfinished story of the first game - the adventures of a group of heroes from the Beast nation. The sequel focuses on two of the previous game's main characters, Badio and his sweetheart Miriana. Traveling by ship, the couple arrives in a small city in the Eastern continent, where they meet a dying warrior from the Dragon tribe, who is holding a child in his arms, begging the heroes to bring him safely to his people. But Badio and his friends know it won't be easy, when they are attacked by a group of Beast Hunters, and when the powerful enemies continue plotting their schemes against the heroes...

The gameplay is very similar to that of the first game, with a few minor changes. As before, there is no exploration or movement outside the battles; the entire game consists of long strategic fights and cut scenes. Once again, the player has access to beast transformation for the characters in the party. The player-controlled characters level up automatically, but this time can level up in the middle of the battle. The "Defend" command is now available, requiring 1 action point. Some changes were made to the interface (different icons, design of the menus, etc.), but otherwise, nothing essential has been changed compared to the previous game.

[From [url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/44435/last-guardian-2-yomi-no-fuin/]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
《兽乡之守护者2：黄泉之封印》是《兽乡之守护者》系列初代作品的正统续作，承接了前作未竟的故事——一群来自兽族之国的英雄们的冒险历程。本作以初代的两位主要角色——帕迪欧与他的恋人咪莉安娜为中心展开。两人乘船远行，抵达东方大陆的一座小城，并在当地遇见了一名来自土龙族的垂死战士。那名战士怀抱一名幼童，苦苦哀求英雄们将孩子平安护送回族人身边。然而，随着“兽杀队”袭来，加之幕后强敌仍在暗中针对英雄们编织重重阴谋，帕迪欧与伙伴们深知此行绝不会一帆风顺…

游戏玩法与初代十分相似，仅作出了少许微调。与前作相同，战斗之外依然没有探索或移动环节，整部作品由漫长的策略战斗与过场剧情组成。玩家同样可以让队伍中的角色进行兽化变身。我方角色依旧会自动升级，但本作支持在战斗中途直接升级；此外还新增了消耗1点行动点数的“防御”指令。游戏界面也经过了部分调整（更换了图标与菜单设计等），但除此之外，核心机制较前作并无本质变化。

[摘自[url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/44435/last-guardian-2-yomi-no-fuin/]MobyGames[/url]]
